_comment: Opt-in only. Never merge this into .cursor/mcp.json as a cohort default — see AGENTIC-HARNESS.md 'GitHub MCP: opt-in only' for why. This is GitHub's own official github/github-mcp-server, run via its published Docker image (requires Docker; the project already uses Docker for `make up`, so this adds no new tooling). Requires GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN in your own .env (copy .env.example -> .env at the repo root, fill in your token, never commit .env). See https://github.com/github/github-mcp-server for auth modes and scopes — SSH keys do not work here, only OAuth/PAT/GitHub App.
